item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo bka' gsang dbang gi lha mo'i yang snying gsang sgrub phrin
item.coloph: kho bo mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pas/ sa mo lug gi hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu la/ gyim shod zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba nas spyan drangs te/ slar shel brag tshal du bla chen dran pa'i phyag bris la btugs pa'o/ yig ge pa ni gyer btsun tshul ming wer zhis bgyis pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/
